operations.name: get_organization
operations.description: Get the Zoho Books organization profile: name, base currency, country, time zone, fiscal year start, and tax basis.

operations.name: list_chart_of_accounts
operations.description: List the chart of accounts (id, code, name, type). Optional client-side filter by account_type substring (income, expense, bank, etc.).

operations.name: list_taxes
operations.description: List tax rates (id, name, percentage, type) configured for the org.

operations.name: list_bank_accounts
operations.description: List bank/cash accounts (deposit and paid-through accounts) with id, name, type, currency, and balance.

operations.name: list_items
operations.description: List items (products/services) with id, name, rate, description, and tax.
